actions.name: Gain unauthorized access to victim networks through phishing emails with malicious zip file attachment
actions.description: OnePercent Group actors gain unauthorized access to victim networks through phishing emails with a malicious zip file attachment.

actions.name: Infect victim system with IcedID banking trojan via malicious macros
actions.description: The zip file includes a Microsoft Word or Excel document that contains malicious macros that allow the actors to subsequently infect the victim’s system with the banking Trojan IcedID.

actions.name: Use IcedID to install and execute Cobalt Strike on victim network
actions.description: The actors use IcedID to install and execute the software Cobalt Strike on the victim’s network.

actions.name: Move laterally within victim network using PowerShell remoting
actions.description: Cobalt Strike moves laterally in the network, primarily with PowerShell remoting.

actions.name: Exfiltrate data from victim network using rclone
actions.description: The actors use rclone for data exfiltration from the victim’s network.

actions.name: Deploy ransomware on victim network
actions.description: The actors deploy ransomware on the victim network after approximately one month of presence.

actions.name: Send ransom note stating data encrypted and exfiltrated with instructions to contact via TOR
actions.description: After initially gaining access, OnePercent Group actors leave a ransom note stating the data has been encrypted and exfiltrated, instructing the victim to contact them on TOR.

actions.name: Threaten victim via emails and phone calls to leak data if no prompt communication
actions.description: If the victim does not make prompt communication within a week of infection, the actors follow up with emails and phone calls threatening to leak data.

actions.name: Threaten to release portion of stolen data to clearnet websites if ransom not paid quickly
actions.description: If the victim does not pay the ransom quickly, the actors threaten to release a portion of the stolen data to various clearnet websites.

actions.name: Threaten to sell stolen data to Sodinokibi Group for auction if ransom not paid in full
actions.description: If the ransom is not paid in full after the 'one percent leak', OnePercent Group actors threaten to sell the stolen data to the Sodinokibi Group to publish at an auction.

actions.name: Contact victims via phone calls with ransom demands using spoofed numbers
actions.description: Once ransomware is deployed, victims receive phone calls through spoofed phone numbers with ransom demands.

actions.name: Provide ProtonMail email address for further communication and negotiation
actions.description: Victims are provided a ProtonMail email address for further communication and negotiation.

actions.name: Send subsequent threats to publish stolen data via ProtonMail if victim does not respond
actions.description: When a victim company does not respond, the actors send subsequent threats to publish the stolen data via the same ProtonMail email address.
